quote: He took me and my two nephews out fishing, and we had an absolute blast. We ended up catching over 80 fish! It was non-stop action, and the boys haven't stopped talking about it since.
name: Kyle N.

quote: Captain Ashmore did a fantastic job of putting us on the fish all day long! He kept everyone engaged with his knowledge of Tampa Bay and its ecosystem.
name: Randy P.

quote: Although the fish weren't biting great the captain tried multiple locations and different baits until we started catching some. My son had a memorable 12th birthday. He'll never forget catching a shark!
name: Darby L. H.

quote: He knew right where to take us so we could catch plenty of fish!!! Would recommend him to anyone and we will be going again in the near future
name: Chelsey H.

quote: We booked a last minute fishing trip two days before Christmas and had a great time! Caught enough fish to feed the whole family for Christmas dinner
name: Xella D.
